MAR.note: Nothing on a rule or authority against AI harms.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition told parliament its Idarati assistant, fed with about 2,800 structured administrative procedures and nearly 10,000 legal texts, is to expand coverage and add a voice version.

MAR.note: No AI tool in a sector's public system stated.

facts.fact: Minister Ahmed Rahou told parliament's Interior Committee Morocco expects the first open-source national language model and is running first trials adapting a model to Darija, building on about 300 million text tokens and 10,000 hours of Darija audio.
The ministry reports it is continuing a partnership with Core Nexus Systems for an advanced computing platform with a target capacity of 36 MW.

facts.fact: The ministry says the first of Oracle's two cloud regions, in Casablanca, enters operation in 2026, an investment of about MAD 1.4 billion.
The ministry's 2026 budget execution to mid-October shows MAD 1.73 billion in final appropriations open, 6.31 percent committed (about MAD 108.9 million) and 88.23 percent of committed sums paid.
